title: It’s a sMall world after all? Possible Disney connection? Gate, mall world, water world, backrooms etc
content: After reading hundreds of comments from other gate kids having mall world dreams…. I’m realizing a lot of us might have strong connections to Disney in some way. It could be anything from going to the parks (I went dozens of times and even lived in the Disney neighborhood celebration). I grew up with severe constant trauma and abuse (project monarch? ) and my comfort movies were Cinderella, Little mermaid, sleeping beauty etc.Theres many who talk about Disney movie programming and hidden messages, secret club 33, unused underground Disney tunnels, Walt Disney as a mason , Epcot original proposals, etc. Fun fact too…, the town I was born and raised actually where Walt disney first wanted to build and my town said no. I was in the Disney Art program, went to Disney dozens of times before 8years old, wanted to be an Imagineer, wanted to be a Disney princess at the parks, etc. My theory is that Walt is involved in a huge way. He always spoke about the “dreamers”. Maybe mall world was made for us originally to dream and create, but then certain people used it to control us and harness our energy and keep us asleep. I think the backrooms we all remember we visit in the astral plane, but part of me feels I went to backrooms and liminal space IRL, possibly the Disney backrooms/underground levels. That part disturbs me because I have always felt like I have actually been there, but maybe my memory blocks it out. Does anyone in mall world have a connection to Disney, Florida, the gate program, Disney owned summer camps, loved the movies, loved the children’s books, etc? Or even feeling like you might have been to liminal space/ backroom/ indoor water park IRL?? Please let’s connect. We need to uncover everything we can about this. I feel it is vital.
